name: Dragon Horn Tavern
description: Dragon Horn is a lively karaoke venue known for its relaxed, neighborhood dive bar atmosphere. It offers regular karaoke nights, often on Fridays and Saturdays, featuring live music and karaoke performances. The venue has a small but decent sound system, a good variety of song choices, and a friendly staff that makes everyone feel welcome. Though it lacks food service, it provides a great environment for fun, casual singing nights with a diverse crowd and a laid-back vibe.
